requirements: An administrator can list approved event manifests newest first.
Reading approved events does not reserve capacity or mutate lifecycle state.
A non-administrator cannot list approved event manifests.
The admin portal visualizes event demand, placement, and capacity without lifecycle controls.

observations.detail: GET /api/v1/events returned 405 for both the admin and non-admin contract tests because no collection read endpoint existed.
The test suite could not resolve ./Events because the read-only Events page did not exist.
